question: Related Questions Q. REGARDING USE OF SWEETS OF DIWALI. 12332 views Q. Machine-Cut Halal? 16897 views Q. I work in a islamic branch of a conventional bank in Pakistan. I used to work in a interest based bank before and have friends who are still working in interst based banks. 1). Therefore, sometimes if I go meet them either they offer me food or drinks from their income or bank's petty funds as it is customary in offices, please tell me if it is jahiz or not. OR 2). They invite me in thier marriages OR other functions, I have to eat or drink with them from the food or drinks which are purchased from their own income. please give me your fatwa if it is permitted or not. 3). Since I am working in a Islamic branch of a conventional interest based bank. The working and functionality of our branch is Shariah compliant and approved as such from State bank of pakistan. State bank of pakistan has a Shariah board menned by Shariah Scholars who give license for islamic banking to either full fledged islamic banks OR standalone branches for islamic banking of conventional banks and operations of these branches are separate from conventional banking branches. What I like to know that sometimes I have to attend functions / attend meetings where I have to drink tea or eat food sponsored by conventional interest based banking branches. Since these are official meetings, functions, or calls then it is very very difficult to say NO in such circumstances. answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 151137 Country: India Title: Is E-631 haram or halal? Question: My question is that there is a chemical component which mixes with pizzas and chips also. Component is E-631. While I search this on Google it shows that this is originated from pig which is not acceptable. So I am very confused about the information provided on Google and other social sites. Please provide me an answer. Answer ID: 151137 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1176/1155/L=9/1438) Merely on the news of Google and other websites the definite ruling of unlawfulness cannot be applied. However it is better to avoid in case of doubt out of piety. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
